lede: Grand Theft Auto V surfaced on two feeds at once today, holding a Steam charts spot alongside a widely watched send-off video on YouTube that drew 448,090 views. The heaviest live crowd sat elsewhere: Counter-Strike 2 pulled 1,337,437 concurrent players on Steam, the day's single largest gathering. On Wikipedia, the most-read article was the killing of the Clancy children, at 466,193 views.
